scope: Cross-part consistency of source-qualified nominal stock proposals; no new source facts or whole-record approvals.

cases.current_reason: Verify the original ATCC stock preparation, percent basis (w/v or w/w), solvent and hydrate status before proposing a quantitatively defined stock.
Recover the percent basis, acid stereochemistry and supplied solution specification for the JCM87 titrant before minting a quantitative stock or selecting a pure solute identity.
Recover the original ATCC percent-basis and preparation for the 25% sodium acetate stock before a quantitative exact formulation proposal.
Verify NBRC989 supplied product/stereochemistry and percentage basis; correct the TOGO-derived G_PER_L occurrence from the primary ml quantity before mapping the stock.

assessment: All four primary source contexts specify nominal stock strength. Unspecified percent basis, starting hydrate, stereochemistry or solvent are real limits but do not by themselves prevent a source-qualified local nominal identity with UNKNOWN component-list completeness; B and C already use this bounded representation for comparably incomplete stock formulations. No exact pure-solute identity or globally resolving raw alias is suggested.
acceptance: Produce conservative isolated stock proposals with exact source references and preserved unknowns, or identify a materially different source-identity blocker; independently review final payloads and their case backlinks.
excluded_case_65: Initial hemin solvent volume and final concentration are not specified; separate initial-stock boundary is less well defined, so no compulsory proposal requested here.
